## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 基础分区过滤 (几乎所有查询)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- 常见业务过滤
  AND content_type = 'shopee_video'
  AND video_play_cnt_ntl_1d > 0
  AND user_id > 0

-- 指定地域过滤 (Content Ads 场景)
WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
  AND grass_date >= date('${DAYS_AGO_8}')
  AND grass_date <= date('${DAYS_AGO_1}')

-- 视频观看时长过滤 (I2V Swing Score 场景)
  AND video_view_duration_ntl_1d > 0
  AND video_id > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN 视频-商品绑定表 (通过 video_id = content_id)
JOIN video.video_mart_dim_content_item_bind_df b
  ON c.video_id = b.content_id

-- JOIN 广告维表 (过滤已创建广告的视频)
WHERE video_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT post_id
  FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
  WHERE grass_date = date('${date}')
    AND grass_region = 'ID'
)
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 按视频聚合播放量 (需先 MAX 去重再 SUM，避免用户维度重复)
SELECT video_id,
       SUM(video_play_cnt_ntl_1d) as video_play_cnt_ntl_7d
FROM (
  SELECT video_id, user_id, grass_date,
         MAX(video_play_cnt_ntl_1d) as video_play_cnt_ntl_1d
  FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
  WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
    AND grass_date >= date('${START}')
    AND grass_date <= date('${END}')
    AND content_type = 'shopee_video'
    AND video_play_cnt_ntl_1d > 0
  GROUP BY video_id, user_id, grass_date
)
GROUP BY video_id

-- 按 entry_point + region + ads_id 聚合广告曝光
SELECT grass_region,
       entry_point,
       ads_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_item_ads = 1
                 OR video_ads_type IN ('product_ads', 'video_ads')
                THEN video_play_cnt_ntl_1d ELSE 0 END) AS ads_impr_cnt,
       SUM(video_play_cnt_ntl_1d) AS total_impr_cnt
FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND video_play_cnt_ntl_1d > 0
GROUP BY grass_region, entry_point, ads_id

-- I2V 场景: 提取 video-user 关系
SELECT DISTINCT video_id, user_id
FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
WHERE grass_date = date('${date}')
  AND grass_region = 'ID'
  AND user_id > 0
  AND video_id > 0
  AND video_view_duration_ntl_1d > 0
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Discovery Ads — Entry Point VV 聚合 (video_vv_with)

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW video_vv AS
SELECT grass_region,
    CASE WHEN sv_source_page = 'iaa_dd_video_card'
              AND current_page IN ('common_video_feed_page', 'dd_video_new_landing_page')
              AND video_flow_type = 'internal'
              AND content_type = 'shopee_video' THEN 'DD Internal Video'
         WHEN sv_source_page = 'home_video_module'
              AND current_page = 'common_video_trending_page'
              AND video_flow_type = 'internal' THEN 'HP Internal Video'
         WHEN sv_source_page = 'video_tab'
              AND current_page = 'trending_page' THEN 'Video Trending Tab'
         WHEN sv_source_page = 'iaa_srp_video_card'
              AND current_page = 'common_video_feed_page'
              AND video_flow_type = 'internal' THEN 'SRP Internal Video'
         WHEN sv_source_page = 'iaa_dd_mix_item'
              AND current_page = 'mix_feed_page'
              AND content_type = 'shopee_video'
              AND video_flow_type = 'internal' THEN 'Daily Discover Mix Feed Video Internal'
         WHEN sv_source_page = 'iaa_ymal_video_card'
              AND current_page = 'common_video_feed_page'
              AND content_type = 'shopee_video'
              AND video_flow_type = 'internal' THEN 'YMAL_FEED_VIDEO_ADS'
         ELSE 'Undefined'
    END AS entry_point,
    ads_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_item_ads = 1 OR video_ads_type IN ('product_ads','video_ads')
             THEN video_play_cnt_ntl_1d ELSE 0 END) AS content_video_ads_impr_cnt,
    SUM(video_play_cnt_ntl_1d) AS content_video_total_impr_cnt
FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND video_play_cnt_ntl_1d > 0
GROUP BY grass_region, entry_point, ads_id
```

### Snippet 2: Content Ads — 视频播放量排名 (20260424_kongbiao)

```sql
SELECT video_id,
       SUM(video_play_cnt_ntl_7d) AS video_play_cnt_ntl_7d
FROM (
    SELECT video_id, user_id, grass_date,
           MAX(video_play_cnt_ntl_1d) AS video_play_cnt_ntl_7d
    FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
    WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
      AND grass_date >= date('${DAYS_AGO_8}')
      AND grass_date <= date('${DAYS_AGO_1}')
      AND content_type = 'shopee_video'
      AND video_play_cnt_ntl_1d > 0
    GROUP BY video_id, user_id, grass_date
)
GROUP BY video_id
```

### Snippet 3: I2V Swing Score — 提取 video-user 对 (i2v_swing_score)

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT video_id, user_id
FROM video.video_mart_dws_user_watch_basic_aggr_1d
WHERE grass_date = date('2024-12-15')
  AND grass_region = 'ID'
  AND user_id > 0
  AND video_id > 0
  AND video_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT post_id
      FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
      WHERE grass_date = date('2024-12-15')
        AND grass_region = 'ID'
  )
  AND video_view_duration_ntl_1d > 0
```
